items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: The interviewee explains that 'Cookie' is a nickname used by others to refer to himself ('they called me Cookie'), not a separate person.

ctx.x: Well, you weren't the...I thought they called you Cookie, I know.

Yeah, well, they called me Cookie on the kind of, you know, playing the number, you see. And of course, I used to sing it over there, too. And they all got to know it and sing it. And then they would have called me LeClaire. It was one of those things. Everywhere I went, they said, where's Cookie? Well, that was strange.
But what's ones and twos? Ones and twos, you know, you give me a ones and twos.
